speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Heart Disease (Atrial Septal Defect) leading to Pulmonary Hypertension and Right-Sided Heart Failure.

The normal cardiac workup rules out primary valve issues or myocardial failure, while the confirmed atrial septal defect explains the fluid overload (edema, ascites) and liver enlargement due to chronic right-sided pressure overload. The rapid breathing is likely due to pulmonary venous congestion from the left-to-right shunt.
